concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a diverse team in a modern meeting room with natural light, warm colors, and a relaxed atmosphere. The team is seated around a wooden table, engaged in discussion. Use a medium shot, 45-degree camera angle, and include a cityscape outside the window. The mood is collaborative and inclusive.
concepts.title: Diverse Business Team Meeting
concepts.description: A group of diverse professionals sitting around a table in a modern meeting room, engaged in discussion and collaboration. The room is filled with natural light and has a city view.

concepts.subject: Person Meditating Outdoors
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a person meditating in a serene outdoor setting, surrounded by nature. The scene is lit with soft, warm sunlight, and the atmosphere is peaceful. Use a low-angle shot, looking up at the person, and include a blurred background of trees and flowers. The mood is calm and contemplative.
concepts.title: Person Meditating in Nature
concepts.description: A person sitting in a peaceful outdoor setting, surrounded by trees and flowers, meditating and practicing mindfulness. The scene is filled with soft, warm sunlight.

concepts.subject: Delicious Fresh Fruit Salad
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a vibrant and colorful fresh fruit salad, arranged in a modern bowl. The scene is lit with bright, natural light, and the atmosphere is appetizing. Use a top-down shot, directly above the bowl, and include a variety of fruits such as strawberries, blueberries, and pineapple. The mood is fresh and inviting.
concepts.title: Fresh Fruit Salad with Variety
concepts.description: A colorful and fresh fruit salad, arranged in a modern bowl, featuring a variety of fruits such as strawberries, blueberries, and pineapple.

concepts.subject: Person Working on Laptop
concepts.image_prompt: Create a photo of a person working on a laptop in a modern coffee shop. The scene is lit with warm, cozy lighting, and the atmosphere is productive. Use a medium shot, 45-degree camera angle, and include a blurred background of coffee cups and people. The mood is focused and concentrated.
concepts.title: Person Working on Laptop in Coffee Shop
concepts.description: A person sitting in a modern coffee shop, working on a laptop, surrounded by coffee cups and people. The scene is filled with warm, cozy lighting.

concepts.subject: Beautiful Sunset Landscape
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a stunning sunset landscape, featuring a serene lake and mountains in the background. The scene is lit with warm, golden light, and the atmosphere is peaceful. Use a wide-angle shot, looking out at the landscape, and include a few trees and rocks in the foreground. The mood is calm and majestic.
concepts.title: Serene Sunset Landscape with Lake
concepts.description: A beautiful sunset landscape, featuring a serene lake and mountains in the background, with a few trees and rocks in the foreground.

concepts.subject: Diverse Group of Friends

Use a medium shot, 45-degree camera angle, and include a variety of people with different abilities, ages, and ethnicities. The mood is joyful and celebratory.
concepts.title: Diverse Group of Friends Socializing
concepts.description: A diverse group of friends, from different cultures and backgrounds, socializing and having fun together, featuring people with different abilities, ages, and ethnicities.

concepts.title: Person Practicing Yoga in Nature
concepts.description: A person practicing yoga in a serene outdoor setting, surrounded by trees and flowers, with a blurred background and soft, warm sunlight.

concepts.description: A diverse group of people walking in a city street, featuring people with different abilities, ages, and ethnicities, surrounded by urban elements such as buildings, cars, and pedestrians.
